news_summary: Frontken issuer Q2/H1 report shows quarterly revenue rising to RM186.906 million from RM156.432 million and attributable profit to RM47.723 million from RM33.489 million; half-year attributable earnings grew 40%. September 21-22 issuer-hosted media records Taiwan capacity purchases of about RM118 million. Other operating income rose materially, so profit growth cannot all be attributed to core revenue; the quarterly report publication date was not retrieved, although reporting periods were verified.
